title: onprem: airgap offline bundle + vendor rke2/flatcar EFI support
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Add EFI-compatible vendoring and offline bundle generation for RKE2 + Flatcar. Installer now supports UEFI-only hosts; customers should regenerate offline bundles for new installs. No API or runtime breaking changes.
description: Motivation: customers running on Flatcar and other UEFI-only platforms were unable to boot some air-gapped installer artifacts due to missing EFI artifacts and incomplete vendoring of RKE2 system images. This PR expands the offline bundler's vendoring surface to include EFI boot files for Flatcar, pins RKE2 artifacts used in airgap bundles, and updates the bundle layout so the installer can detect and use UEFI binaries automatically. Summary of changes: - Add EFI artifact download and packaging steps to installer/scripts/generate-airgap-bundle.sh - Vendor additional Flatcar/EFI files under installer/vendor/flatcar/efi/ - Add rke2 artifact pinning and sha256 verification in installer/vendor/rke2/ - Update helm charts and kubelet systemd unit templates to prefer UEFI boot paths when present - Add a compatibility shim that falls back to legacy non-EFI bundles for existing offline bundles Compatibility: runtime behavior is unchanged for hosted installers. For on-prem offline bundles generated before this change, the installer will continue to work but will not gain EFI support until bundles are regenerated. Testing: local end-to-end airgap install on Flatcar (UEFI) and Ubuntu (legacy BIOS) in lab, image verifications via sha256, and CI matrix run for generate-bundle and smoke install. See testing_summary for details. Rollout: merged to main; recommendation is to publish a new offline bundle artifact and inform SRE/customers via release notes and support ticket referencing SUP-3341. Backout: revert the vendoring commit and republish prior bundle if an issue is found.
commits:
1) add: vendor flatcar EFI assets and update bundle generator
2) feat: pin rke2 artifacts + sha256 verification
3) fix: update systemd kubelet unit for UEFI kernel args
4) test: add e2e airgap testcases for UEFI installs
5) docs: note regen requirement for offline bundles
review_conversation:
Miguel Torres (Reviewer): Can we validate SHA sums for the EFI artifacts as well?
Ava Chen (Author): Added sha256 checks for all downloaded artifacts and fail-fast on mismatch; see pinned hashes in installer/vendor/rke2/artifacts.json and vendor/flatcar/efi/sha256sums.txt.
Jordan Patel (Reviewer): The systemd unit change looks environment-sensitive; can you explain fallback behavior?
Ava Chen: The unit will detect presence of /opt/redwood/efi/BOOTX64.EFI and set kernel args accordingly, otherwise it preserves previous behavior. Added unit tests in test_airgap_uefi_install.sh to cover both paths.
Sofia Ibrahim (Security): Are any of these new artifacts from untrusted sources? Do we have provenance?
Ava Chen: All artifacts are fetched from vendor-hosted signed releases (Flatcar and Rancher), we store SHA256 and source URLs in artifacts.json and include verification in the bundle generator. Added notes in docs/onprem/offline-bundles.md.
Miguel: CI flaked on the first run, re-ran and all checks passed. Approving now.
Merge: squashed and merged by Ava Chen.
ci_details: CI matrix: generate-bundle (pass), e2e-airgap(ubuntu) (pass), e2e-airgap(flatcar-uefi) (pass), lint (pass), build (pass). First pipeline had a transient docker registry timeout; retriggered and green.
testing_summary: Lab tests: - Fresh offline bundle generated locally with vendor artifacts and published to internal s3-mirror. - Performed full installer run in isolated VLAN against Flatcar AMI with UEFI-only boot and RKE2 v1.24 pinned artifacts. Cluster reached Ready state and agent connected; smoke requests succeeded. - Verified sha256 of all artifacts before and after packaging. - Ran rollback test by replacing vendor artifacts with previous bundle: installer fell back to legacy path and install completed. CI: added e2e job for flatcar-uefi that runs in our isolated infra pool.
notes_for_ops: Ops should publish a new offline bundle artifact after merge and update internal KB with regeneration command: scripts/regenerate-bundle.sh --channel stable --include-efi. Notify customers on SUP-3341. No changes to private control plane required.

Users: regenerate offline bundles to enable UEFI support.
